contra: Gramatura: página e ficha dizem 260 g; TODOS os 15 arquivos de foto se chamam 'moletom_canguru_2_cabos_basico_240gsm'. Ou a foto é de outro produto (240 g, 'básico'), ou a gramatura mudou.
Nome dos arquivos diz 'básico' e não 'peluciado' — pode ser uma versão anterior sem escovação.
Cor: aqui o texto diz que o ALGODÃO dá 'fixação de cor superior em tons escuros'; no P26 diz que é o POLIÉSTER.
'Dois fios torcidos juntos antes da tecelagem' — moletom é malha, não tecelagem; '2 cabos' não é fio retorcido.
Tabela comparativa cita 'Gola Careca 260g R$ 54,00' e 'Moletom 100% CO 320g' — produtos não catalogados; o gola careca que temos (P26) é 320 g e R$ 59,00.

prompt.model_desc: a Caucasian Brazilian man in his early 30s, athletic-lean build, medium-length dark brown hair slicked back and tied into a low bun, short groomed beard with moustache, defined eyebrows, serious calm expression
prompt.garment: a regular-fit pullover hoodie in 260gsm two-thread fleece (50% cotton / 50% polyester) with a soft brushed fleece inside, {COR}, smooth matte outer face, a lined double-layer hood with a neat crossover at the front of the neck, a flat natural-cream cotton drawcord hanging in two strands to mid-chest, a front kangaroo pocket with slanted side openings and topstitched edges, set-in sleeves with the shoulder seam on the shoulder point, 1x1 ribbed cuffs and a 1x1 ribbed waistband at the hip
prompt.bottom: light-blue faded slim jeans with small rips at the thighs
prompt.colors: PRT, MAR, OFF, BGE (camelo nas fotos), MRR
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: medium-heavy 260gsm fleece, soft and cozy, draping in rounded folds. The double-layer hood holds a full rounded shape standing around the neck when down, the inner layer in the same color visible at the opening. Kangaroo pocket with double-needle topstitched edges and reinforced corners; tonal reinforced seams; shoulder-to-shoulder tape; the ribbed cuffs and waistband gather softly with slight blousing above them. Fully matte, no sheen. Movement: soft and pliable — when the hands go into the pocket, the front panel pulls into gentle diagonal tension folds; the sleeves bunch softly above the cuffs; the drawcords swing freely.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): regular fit — body length 72 cm with the ribbed waistband at the hip over the jeans; chest width 54 cm flat (about 108 cm around) giving relaxed ease; shoulder 46 cm with the seam on the shoulder point; sleeve 62 cm from shoulder to cuff end, the cuff at the wrist.
